saw_lines: Fruit buyers can’t judge ripeness online, so they pick on trust in the farm and the harvest date.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if the farm story is worth a click.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on every creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to trust a farm they cannot visit. Collect one number, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it.
0 of 15 copy ads mention an offer, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act now, a first order offer on the 13 kilo orange box, and lead three ads with it.

23 ads have run 60 days or more, but none of your 7 newer ads reuses a winner’s hook, so new tests start cold. Build three variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and swapping the product.

Your 15 copy ads open with 9 different stories, and the biggest one leads only 3 ads, so no story is tested hard enough to show what works. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.
